summary: The verification record names its reopen gate (cinatra#4312). Adds nullable artifact_verification_records.reopened_gate_id (FK to artifact_review_gates, ON DELETE SET NULL), written by the verification in the transaction that inserts the reopen gate, and read as the proof that a verification-reopen gate joins a repair lineage. A backfill, run once here, names a gate in the record's slot only when it already carries a repair row at attempt 2 or later, on the same run and organization, created at or after the record; a reopen gate pending at the upgrade with no note stays unnamed. The review orchestration sweep repeats the statement for a note an old writer adds after the upgrade; since the statement reads only the repair rows, it also names a caller's gate in the slot that a hand-written row at attempt 2 or later rests on. Fresh-install bootstrap twin in lifecycleInterceptionsSchemaQueries.
